svg.title: How Context Relay works: one change, three checkpoints
svg.desc: Illustrated configured workflow. You change the export format from CSV to JSON. First, when Relay recognises the correction, it includes JSON in later model requests. Your model proposes an action. Second, the registered tool runs only after its configured checks pass; the example proposal and required format are both JSON. Your tool writes the file. Third, your application's verifier reads the destination and checks the expected result. Basic connection adds supported memory; tool checks and outcome verification require additional setup. Before execution, failed checks can lead to a safe correction, clarification or stop. An unverified outcome remains unfinished. An action that has started is not automatically repeated.

path.aria-label: Follow a JSON export from your request to the saved file.
Actually, use JSON instead of CSV.
IF A CHECK DOES NOT PASS
Before the tool: correct safely, clarify or stop.
After the tool: keep the task open until resolved.
